review_independence_note: Role-separated sequential passes occurred in one orchestration context; they are not counted as independent or mutually blind review.

activation.note: Research-only theory/benchmark/paper artifacts. No active behavior depends on unexecuted Round-012 benchmark results.

saturation.reason: Six non-duplicate objects survived deduplication and introduced new hostile falsifiers for map vacuity, query-family scope and dynamic false friends.

next_ai.positive: Implement the smallest research-only similarity-witness schema with probe_family, mapping_family, mapping_constraints, preserved/not-preserved correspondences and distinguishing certificates; execute both Round-011 and Round-012 frozen worlds before activation.
next_ai.null: If capacity-controlled certification does not reduce false/vacuous matches versus unrestricted explicit mappings under matched retrieval/model budgets, preserve the null and remove runtime complexity while retaining the scientific warning in the paper.
next_ai.refuted: If prior work contains a semantically equivalent combination of predeclared mapping-capacity contracts, query-family refinement, immutable distinguishing probes and authority-gated scientific analogy, preserve the refuter and narrow the paper contribution.
next_ai.partial_id: If only some relation families admit monotone probe refinement or tractable map-capacity constraints, keep those laws local to licensed relation types and mark others unknown.
next_ai.blocked: If mapping complexity or distinguishing-probe ground truth cannot be frozen without post-hoc judgment, mark the affected benchmark CANNOT_CHECK and do not tune admissible families on the evaluation packet.
next_ai.transport: If main moves before commit, refetch and rebuild on the new head without force-updating the branch.
